continuation_policy: Use the frozen eager DDQN action for policy-quality evaluation. Independently execute the already frozen exported runtime on every state, require Q-value numerical agreement at the original tolerance, and record every action disagreement as deployment-equivalence evidence.
existing_evaluation_artifacts: Never overwrite. Preserve and hash all 919 completed learned episodes and their arrays.
missing_evaluation_artifacts: Create only missing learned and heuristic evaluation episodes from the original reserved evaluation seeds.
training: No retraining, no optimizer update, no checkpoint selection and no changed model parameters.
